industry.why: Neutral, carried, split: Kofler (Jefferies, 21 and 26-Nov) finds 2028 free-cash-flow yields of 7 to 10% at the big miners and calls steel 'a decent place to be into next year', LaFemina (21-Nov) says the mining recovery needs the end of Fed tightening and 'may take time', and no source spoke to chemicals. Relative strength D (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; C prior). Base chemicals, Steel, Cement and Construction carry D; Fragrances, Specialty chemicals and Forestry stay C. No change.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, with the disagreement stated: relative strength A (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; B prior), two readings at A or B, against no source speaking to chemicals and multiples that are high for a regime that sells duration. Eight Pool names (Symrise, Kerry, Givaudan, Corbion, DKSH, Tate and Lyle, Interparfums, Puig), with Symrise and Kerry in the top fifteen of the starting score. Counter-case: consumer-staple-linked demand is defensive and the market has paid for two months. To B when a source carries an ingredients read with relative strength holding A or B.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. The one Spanish item is sector-level (Kepler constructive on Indra as Spain lifts defence spending, 26-Nov); Iberia's market read arrived unreadable; relative strength is not graded by country. One live holding, Arteche (3.02%). An absence is an absence; no tilt.
